description: This file defines the Filter class within the Opencart admin task controller namespace. The class manages tasks related to catalog filters, including generating country lists, country info, and clearing country JSON files. It interacts with multiple models such as task, store, language, country, zone, geo_zone, and setting to fetch data, generate tasks, and manage JSON files.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: Controller class managing catalog filtering tasks such as listing, info retrieval, and cleanup.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes tasks for articles and country listings across stores and languages.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Generates a JSON list of countries for a specific store and language, saving it to a file.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Fetches detailed info for a specific country, generating a JSON file with country, zone, and geo-zone details.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes existing JSON files related to countries for all stores and languages.
